parts.name: Cabinet Door (Lower)
parts.Basic_description: This is the lower cabinet door of the storage cabinet, made of MDF with a smooth finish.
parts.Functional_description: It covers and protects the lower storage compartment, allowing access when opened.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about a vertical hinge axis to open and close.

parts.name: Cabinet Door (Upper)
parts.Basic_description: This is the upper cabinet door of the storage cabinet, made of MDF with a smooth finish.
parts.Functional_description: It covers and protects the upper storage compartment, allowing access when opened.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about a vertical hinge axis to open and close.

parts.name: Cabinet Frame
parts.Basic_description: This is the main structural frame of the cabinet, made of plywood for rigidity and durability.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural support and houses the doors and shelves.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed, non-moving structural component.

parts.name: Shelf (Bottom)
parts.Basic_description: This is the bottom shelf of the cabinet, made of particle board.
parts.Functional_description: It supports stored items and divides the internal space.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move.
